package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"time"

	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
func run() error {
	endpoint := flag.String("endpoint", "127.0.0.1:7000", "embedded TCP or Gate endpoint")
	path := flag.String("steps", "", "typed request steps from the current authoritative game view")
	timeout := flag.Duration("timeout", 30*time.Second, "whole scenario deadline")
	flag.Parse()
	if *path == "" || *timeout <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("-steps is required and -timeout must be positive")
	}
	ticket := os.Getenv("ROOST_ROBOT_TICKET")
	if ticket == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("ROOST_ROBOT_TICKET is required")
	}
	file, err := os.Open(*path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	var steps []bots.Step
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err = decoder.Decode(&steps); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = decoder.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
		return fmt.Errorf("steps must contain exactly one JSON array")
	}
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
	defer cancel()
	run := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: *timeout, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: *endpoint}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(ticket), nil }, steps)
	if err = run.Run(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	stats := run.Stats()
	if err = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"scenarios": stats, "requests": run.MessageReport(), "traffic": run.TrafficReport()}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if stats.Success != 1 || stats.Failure != 0 || stats.Canceled != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("business scenario failed")
	}
	return nil
}
